sentences.text: Akaimia was a member of the class Chondrichthyes, a group of cartilaginous fish.
The genus was first described by Jan Rees in 2010.
This genus belongs to the parent group Orectolobiformes.
The animal lived between 165.3 and 161.5 million years ago during the Callovian age.
The type species, A. altucuspis, inhabited southern Poland during the middle or late Jurassic.
Another species, A. myriacuspis, was found in the Oxford Clay near Peterborough during the middle Jurassic.
